hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; if printf '%s' "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)package\.json$|(^|/)tsconfig[^/]*\.json$|(^|/)turbo\.json$|(^|/)\.oxlintrc\.json$|(^|/)\.oxfmtrc\.json$|(^|/)\.claude/rules/.*\.md$|packages/db/.*schema'; then jq -nc --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("Structural file changed (" + $f + ") — check whether docs/architecture/*.md (esp. architecture.md, tech-stack.md) or .claude/rules/tech-stack.md need updating before finishing this task. Use the docs-guardian subagent if so.")}}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
